_readme: The page reads every figure from this file. null means not measured yet: the page shows it as pending. Never put an estimate here. firstLiveRun: examples/first-live-run/ledger.jsonl. demo: the pantry run, docs/demo-run.json (survived = planted bugs that got past their criterion's tests, none of which broke that criterion; invalid = replays that proved nothing). exam: eval/results/summary.json (failingAtDone = exam cases failing when the arm stopped).
